title: Bad Bunny mania comes to France!
summary: old out shows, Grammy awards…and now his own wax figure at Paris’ Musée Grévin inspired by his album "Debi Tirar Mas Photos" ☀️He’s the first Latin american artist to enter the museum and comes as Bad Bunny gives concerts in Paris and Marseille! 🎶@dheepthikalaurent_pro takes a closer look at the artist who is also proudly waving the Puerto Rican flag.
